endReason: No Units remain in the Host. The campaign ends in defeat.

chronicle.text: The Host is assembled. The road to Middelalderen begins here.
chronicle.heading: The March Begins

chronicle.text: The Host is ready to leave the Starting Clearing.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
The Starting Clearing falls behind as the Host steps out beneath a wide, open sky.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: The plains offer distance, wind, and very little else. For once, the march is uneventful.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The Explore Step is complete. When you are ready, reveal what waits at the end of the road.
chronicle.heading: Arrival Step

chronicle.text: The Host reaches a settlement held by the Quietus.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Quietus Rapport changes from Unmet to Neutral.
First Contact roll: 2 + 4 = 6.
The Quietus receive the Host warily, but without open hostility.
Passage has a price. The Quietus require 3 Coin before the Host proceeds.
The Host pays 3 Coin in tribute.

A row of unlit candles blocks the road, each set before a stone bearing no name. Quietus keepers ask your host to pay witness before passing, for some roads are owed to the dead before they are granted to the living.
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

choices.label: Pay Witness (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Rapport with Quietus and 1 Leadership, then lose 1 Morale. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Ask the Keepers (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research or 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Pocket the Candle Silver (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 3 Coin and 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport with Quietus.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 1 Research and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 1P, 1A, 1I, 2L

chronicle.text: You choose: Pay Witness.
Pay Witness: Test 8+
chronicle.heading: The Candle Toll

chronicle.text: Roll: 2, 3, 1 (keep best 2) = 5.
You attempted to Pay Witness, but failed.
Lose 1 Coin.
The Quietus keepers deny your request.
The Host pauses after the march. Draw the Camp hand and see what the road has brought with it.
chronicle.heading: Make Camp

chronicle.text: What began as kin, peddlers, runaways, failed soldiers, and other hangers-on has become something closer to a village on the march. They trail the Baggage Train, sleep beyond the fires, trade among themselves, and answer to no officer. Most are harmless enough. Probably. Lately, however, too many small troubles seem to begin in their part of camp.
chronicle.heading: Riff Raff

chronicle.text: Choose one standard Camp card from the Camp hand, or Work.
chronicle.heading: Choose Camp Action

campOffers.title: Field Staff
campOffers.flavor: A wise commander does not march on courage alone. Scouts find the road, and Stewards keep the Host ready to follow it.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:
Train Scouts: Cost: 1 Coin. Place the Scouting token near the Explore draw deck.

Appoint Camp Steward: Cost: 2 Coin. Place the Camp Steward token near the Camp draw deck.

campOffers.title: Respite
campOffers.flavor: The march pauses long enough for weariness to loosen its grip.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time, Spend 1 Leadership.

Gain 2 Leadership and 1 Morale.

campOffers.title: Work
campOffers.flavor: While the road waits, the Host takes up the work at hand: hauling, mending, tending, building, and drilling for what comes next.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:
  • Gain 2 Coin.
  • Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.
  • Repair Baggage: Spend 1 Wood to repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space.

If you have Camp Steward: After resolving Work, you may search the surrounding area for opportunities. Roll 1d6:
  • 1–4, A Willing Trader: Buy 1 Resource for 1 Coin less than Market Buy (minimum 1 Coin), or sell 1 Resource at Market Sell value.
  • 5–6, A Fortunate Discovery: Gain 1 Resource matching adjacent Terrain for free.
You may purge Baggage contents to make room for a new Resource.

chronicle.text: The Host turns its attention to Work.

Choose Work result
chronicle.heading: Work

choices.label: Repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space — Spend 1 Wood
choices.detail: Unavailable: there are no damaged Baggage Train spaces to repair. Spend 1 Wood. Repair 1 damaged Baggage Train space.

chronicle.text: You choose: Gain 1 Coin and 1 Leadership.
Gain 1 Coin.
Gain 1 Leadership.
The Host is ready to continue the march.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
The march turns green and dim as the Host follows the road beneath the canopy.
chronicle.heading: Forest

chronicle.text: The forest keeps its secrets today. The Host passes beneath the trees without incident.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The Explore Step is complete. When you are ready, reveal what waits at the end of the road.
chronicle.heading: Arrival Step

chronicle.text: The road opens into an unclaimed clearing. The Host takes control without resistance.
chronicle.heading: A Vacant Clearing

chronicle.text: The clearing is secure. Forage before making camp?
chronicle.heading: Arrival

choices.label: Forage
choices.detail: Advance 1 Time. On 4–6, gain 1 Resource matching the adjacent Terrain.

chronicle.text: Advance 1 Time.
Forage roll: 6.
The Host finds useful supplies while foraging.

campOffers.title: Frontier Works
campOffers.flavor: The frontier yields little to those who only pass through. It rewards the ones who leave something behind.
campOffers.effect:

  • Baggage Cart: Cost: 1 Wood

Place the matching token on your Player Board.

campOffers.title: Market Day
campOffers.flavor: The market rarely favors the impatient, but it often rewards the watchful.
campOffers.effect:
If you have constructed a Market, you may also perform this at any Controlled Settlement.

Market: Buy and/or Sell up to 2 Resources at Market value. Subject to Baggage Train capacity.
- or -
Rest: Gain 1 Morale.

campOffers.title: Hire Mercenaries
campOffers.flavor: There are always swords for hire where fear is near and silver is honest.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time Recruit up to 2 Mercenaries (Infantry class) for 1 Coin each.

Mercenaries:
  • May exceed Host MU limits
  • Use white Mercenary tokens.

Reminder: Mercenaries disband in Winter.

Choose construction
chronicle.heading: Frontier Works

choices.label: Market

chronicle.text: Frontier Works is discarded.
The Host is ready to continue the march.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Stone replaces soil beneath the march as the Host works its way into the high country.
chronicle.heading: Mountain

chronicle.text: The climb is hard enough without adding drama. The high road offers no encounter beyond stone, wind, and tired legs.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The Explore Step is complete. When you are ready, reveal what waits at the end of the road.
chronicle.heading: Arrival Step

chronicle.text: The road enters a settlement of the Quietus, where the Host is noticed long before anyone chooses to acknowledge it.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: The Quietus demand 2 Coin in tribute.
The Host cannot provide the demanded 2 Coin in full.
Without tribute, test 8+ to persuade the tribe to allow passage.
chronicle.heading: Passage

chronicle.text: Roll: 5, 5, 2 (keep best 2) = 10.
The passage test succeeds.
The Quietus relent and permit the Host to proceed.
A small sanctuary still stands where the road narrows. Its bell has not rung in years. The keepers ask why your march should disturb what remains consecrated.
chronicle.heading: The Last Bell

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: The Last Bell

choices.label: Religious Contact (8+)
choices.detail: Cost: 1 Leadership. Pass: Gain 1 Rapport with Quietus and 1 Morale. Fail: No additional effect.

choices.label: Restore the Bell (10+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Morale and 1 Research. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Take the Relic (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research and 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport with Quietus.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 1 Research and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Morale. Enemy Host: 1P, 1I, 3L

chronicle.text: You choose: Religious Contact.
Pay 1 Leadership.
Religious Contact: Test 8+
chronicle.heading: The Last Bell

chronicle.text: Roll: 3, 2, 4 (keep best 2) = 7.
The test ends in failure.
The Quietus keepers deny your request.

chronicle.heading: Make Camp

chronicle.text: The road has settled into the Host's bones. Boots split, wheels groan, and every dawn sounds less like a beginning than a sentence being carried out.
chronicle.heading: For Whom the Bell Tolls

chronicle.text: Advance 1 Time.
Morale roll (d10): 4.
The Host finds its rhythm again. The march continues without further consequence.

chronicle.heading: Choose Camp Action

campOffers.title: Raise Local Levies
campOffers.flavor: Not every man who joins the host seeks glory. Some answer because the road has reached their door.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time and Choose 1:

Raise Levies: Spend 1 Food. Add 2 Levy to your Host.

- or -
Rest: Gain 1 Morale.

campOffers.title: Host a Common Table
campOffers.flavor: Bread shared in peace can carry a promise farther than a threat ever will.
campOffers.effect:
Advance 2 Time, Spend 1 Food.

Choose a Neutral or Friendly tribe and test 6+, applying any Rapport DRM. Leadership may not be spent on this test.

  • Pass: Gain 2 Coins and 1 Leadership, then:
    • If the tribe is Neutral, gain 1 Rapport with that tribe.
    • If the tribe is Friendly, gain 1 additional Leadership instead.
  • Fail: No effect.

The spring campaign draws to a close. The Host pauses to reckon with the season behind it.
chronicle.heading: End of Spring

chronicle.text: The Host must reckon with the season before the march continues.
chronicle.heading: End of Spring

chronicle.text: Before the Host can settle its stores, the wider world shifts around it.
The Market shifts, and Hostile tribes may raid the road behind you.
chronicle.heading: Vulnerability

choices.label: Resolve Vulnerability
choices.detail: Roll Market Vulnerability and Barbarian Activation.

chronicle.text: Market Vulnerability die: Wood -.
The Market shifts. Wood falls from 3 to 2 Coin to buy.
Barbarian Activation die: Barbarian icon.
There are signs of movement beyond the road, but no Hostile tribe is able to raid the Host's holdings.
Eligible Terrain produces Food, Wood, and Stone. The supplies will be staged for packing.
chronicle.heading: Harvest

choices.label: Gather the Harvest
choices.detail: Then prepare and pack the Baggage Train.

chronicle.text: Harvest brings in 1 Food, 1 Wood, and 1 Stone. The new supplies are staged beside the Baggage Train before anything is packed away.
The Host packs 1 Wood from the new Harvest.
The remaining 1 Food and 1 Stone cannot be carried and are left behind.
The first two Clearings behind the Host remain. Older parts of the route fall away.
chronicle.heading: Supply Line Consolidation

chronicle.text: The road behind the Host falls out of the Chronicle: 1 Clearing and 0 Terrain cards leave the active route.
End of Spring is complete.
The Host is ready to continue the march.
chronicle.heading: Explore Step

chronicle.text: Advance 2 Time.
Open country stretches ahead, generous with distance and stingy with shelter.
chronicle.heading: Plains

chronicle.text: No riders appear on the horizon and no trouble finds the road. The Host keeps moving.
chronicle.heading: Uneventful Travel

chronicle.text: The Explore Step is complete. When you are ready, reveal what waits at the end of the road.
chronicle.heading: Arrival Step

chronicle.text: The Host reaches a settlement held by the Nightstone.
chronicle.heading: Arrival

chronicle.text: Nightstone Rapport changes from Unmet to Hostile.
First Contact roll: 3 + 2 = 5.
First contact goes badly. The Nightstone receive the Host with open hostility.
The Nightstone demand 1 Wood in tribute.
1 Wood changes hands. Whatever the Nightstone think of the Host, the tribute is paid.
The tribute is accepted, but hostility remains. Test 8+ to secure passage.
chronicle.heading: Passage

chronicle.text: Roll: 4, 3, 5 (keep best 2), DRM -1 = 8.
The passage test succeeds.
The tribute and appeal cool the immediate hostility.
Gain 1 Rapport with Nightstone. The Nightstone are now Neutral.
A tally-house has been split open by looters, and Nightstone clerks accuse every traveler of theft until someone pays for order to be restored.
chronicle.heading: The Broken Ledger

chronicle.text: Choose an approach
chronicle.heading: The Broken Ledger

choices.label: Audit the Losses (8+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Leadership. Fail: Lose 1 Leadership.

choices.label: Settle the Claim (9+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 1 Research or 2 Coin. Fail: Lose 1 Coin.

choices.label: Call Their Bluff (7+)
choices.detail: Pass: Gain 2 Coin. Fail: Lose 1 Rapport with Nightstone.

choices.label: Attack
choices.detail: Win: Gain 2 Coin and 1 Leadership. Disengage: Lose 1 Leadership. Enemy Host: 2A, 1C, 1I

chronicle.text: You choose: Call Their Bluff.
Call Their Bluff: Test 7+
chronicle.heading: The Broken Ledger

chronicle.text: You attempted to Call Their Bluff, but failed.
Lose 1 Rapport with Nightstone. The Nightstone are now Hostile.
The Nightstone wardens reject your terms.
The Nightstone become Hostile and attack.
The Host is destroyed in battle.
